description: POST /v1/capabilities/{key}/invoke: synchronous capability call (no job poll loop). Use only when the capability descriptor lists invoke_sync; use hydracept_run for job-based execution and hydracept_pinned_run for exact model pins. Auth: bearer required. Cost: billed like invoke admission. Side effects: may create invoke audit records.

capability_key.description: Required capability key with invoke_sync in descriptor.
capability_key.title: Capability Key

name: hydracept_invoke
title: Invoke a synchronous capability
